name: crew-agents
description: Tools of the team agent set (subagent status line, agent_name naming hook, agent-handover.ps1 handover) and the proactive-concise output style. The agents themselves (<role>-<model><effort>) live in agents/ at the repo root and load unprefixed through the ~/.claude/agents/claude-shared link (0.8.0: moved out of the plugin, plugin agents always carry the plugin prefix). install.sh / install.ps1 enable it straight from the claude-shared clone.
